review_issues_section.orphans_why: Safafka leh parent_id = NULL — find_parent_by_spatial wuu fashilmay xilligii soo dejinta, inta badan jasiiradaha go'doonka ah ama halka heer ADM dhexe uu ka maqan yahay geoBoundaries (tusaale, Puerto Rico ma lahan saf ADM0/1 isha). Guji saf kasta oo hoose si aad u aragto waalidka musharraxa ah (is-dulsaarka spatial iyo fogaanta centroid) oo aad u diiwaangeliso go'aankaaga.
review_issues_section.parent_assignment_: Waalidka si otomaatig ah loo xalliyay (hanti-dhowrka Wejiga J)

Safafka loo kala saaray istiraatiijiyadda xallinta waalidka. 'direct' waa kiiska caadiga ah (waalidku waa hal heer ka hooseeyaa, looma baahna in la boodo). 'skip_ancestor' waxay ka dhigan tahay in heer la booday (tusaale, CAF heer-6 → CAF heer-4 sababtoo ah heer-5 ma jiro CAF ee geoBoundaries). 'buffered' waxay ka dhigan tahay in loo baahnaa dulqaad 110m ah si polygons-ku isugu dhacaan (isbeddelka digitization-ka ee u dhexeeya heerarka ADM ee isku xiga). Guji chip-ka si aad u faahfaahiso. Tirada cinwaanka kaarka waxay raacaysaa safafka lagu xalliyay heuristic-ka oo kaliya ('skip_ancestor' + 'buffered'); 'direct' waa macluumaad.
review_issues_section.population_assignm: Safafka ay dadkoodu ka yimaadeen raster-ka bedka ee beddelka ah halkii ay ka yimaadeen raster-ka iso-ga ay iyagu leeyihiin. Sida caadiga ah municipios-ka PR ee hoos yimaada USA, halkaas oo raster-ka USA uusan daboolin PR laakiin kan PRI uu daboolo. 'primary' waxay ka dhigan tahay in raster-ka iso-ga safka uu si toos ah u waafaqay. Guji chip-ka isha si aad u faahfaahiso.
review_issues_section.population_gaps_wh: Xuduud awoodeed leh dad = 0 ama NULL. Inta badan waa unugyo miyi ah oo aan dad degganayn heerarka ADM ee ugu hooseeya; heerarka sare (Waddanka, Gobolka, Degmada) waxay u baahan yihiin dib-u-eegis dhow — kuwaas badanaa waxay la xiriiraan bedka.
review_issues_section.review_them: Dib-u-eeg dibadda ama aqbal oo dhammeey rakibaadda — dhibaatooyinku waa macluumaad, mana xannibayaan.
